failure_modes.description: Range estimation accuracy is insufficient for reliable pulse adaptation
failure_modes.evidence: Sea clutter severely corrupts range estimates, making accurate real-time range determination unreliable for pulse adaptation decisions

failure_modes.description: Pulse duration changes inherently increase range-Doppler coupling
failure_modes.evidence: Radar signal processing fundamentals show that varying pulse duration directly alters range-Doppler coupling characteristics, degrading performance

failure_modes.description: The approach fails at grazing angles and high sea states
failure_modes.evidence: Sea clutter models show unpredictable behavior at extreme conditions where adaptive pulse duration would have no predictable benefit

failure_modes.description: Waveform diversity techniques already address this problem more effectively
failure_modes.evidence: Multiple studies demonstrate that joint time-frequency adaptive waveforms outperform simple pulse duration adjustments
Current FPGA processing cannot achieve the microsecond switching times required for effective pulse duration adaptation in practical radar systems

failure_modes.description: The approach degrades performance for low-RCS targets
failure_modes.evidence: Longer pulses reduce range resolution, making small or low-observable targets even harder to detect
